notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The package serves GFootball-11_vs_11_stochastic-simple115-v0: a single agent-controlled player and the simple115 observation. The upstream clone needs the C++ gfootball_engine, OpenCV, gym and numpy, so it was not installed, imported or run, and the fake was not compared with an upstream run. The fake keeps the upstream 115-value simple115 size and 19-action Discrete space but models no players, goals, reward or physics: the 88 player slots stay at the upstream -1 backfill, every reward is 0.0, and only a placeholder ball moves. SMM, Pixels and simple115v2 are not served. The upstream reset() takes no seed or options, so the bridge's cap.world.seed.v1 and reset seed are recorded but cannot change the episode; fidelity determinism is therefore none, and snapshot_restore is false because the fake does not implement get_state/set_state. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's only entry symbol is the factory function gfootball.env:create_environment, but gate G7 requires native to name a class, so native is gfootball.env.football_env:FootballEnv (the class create_environment builds); G7 reports NOT_AN_ENTRY_SYMBOL. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only records the seed), G7.NOT_AN_ENTRY_SYMBOL and G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for observation_space (FootballEnv inherits it from gym.Env; the clone's wrappers set it on the simple115 env), and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (seed twice, action.index, ticks). No catalogue requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
